# A Cold Lands country by its roster region (the economy slice sets the flag on startup).
zin_cold_is_cold = {
	has_country_flag = zin_region_cold_lands
}

# Every lean-holding Cold Lands country: the clans, Horidor, Holdon, Fearno, Windwaith, the Yeti Lands and Titanos; never Coldor, Isengard or Yeldenne.
zin_cold_is_clan_realm = {
	zin_cold_is_cold = yes
	has_variable = zin_cold_lean
	NOT = {
		original_tag = Y01
		original_tag = Y02
		original_tag = Y8H
	}
}

# zin_rule_cold_isengard resolves to HISTORICAL (directly, or DEFAULT under the historical path), through the rules wrapper.
zin_cold_historical = {
	zin_rules_ai_branch_cold_historical = yes
}

# Standard date 1751.3.1, shifted by the story pace.
zin_cold_date_march_open = {
	OR = {
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 } date > 1752.8.31 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.9 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 1.25 } date > 1751.3.1 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.5 } check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 } date > 1750.5.31 }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.5 } date > 1751.3.1 }
	}
}

# The peace gate of the March Forts (section 1): after 1 Thaw 1751 with the dark gathering or Isengard defiant, or after 1 Thaw 1752 under the historical rule; fought once.
zin_cold_march_war_allowed = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_march_war_active }
	country_exists = Y01
	country_exists = Y02
	NOT = { Y01 = { has_country_flag = zin_cold_march_war_fought } }
	NOT = { Y01 = { has_war_with = Y02 } }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			zin_cold_date_march_open = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 14.99 }
				Y02 = { check_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance > 79.99 } }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			zin_cold_historical = yes
			zin_cold_date_march_historical = yes
		}
	}
}

zin_cold_isengard_may_swear = {
	country_exists = Y02
	Y02 = {
		check_variable = { zin_cold_isengard_defiance < 30.01 }
		NOT = { has_war_with = Y01 }
	}
}

# Read by Coldor's The Cold Lands at Peace.
zin_cold_isengard_settled = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_cold_isengard_sworn
		AND = {
			country_exists = Y02
			Y02 = { is_subject_of = Y01 }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = Y02 }
			has_variable = global.zin_cold_isengard_seat
			var:global.zin_cold_isengard_seat = { is_owned_by = Y01 }
		}
	}
}

zin_cold_winter_is_hard = {
	check_variable = { global.zin_cold_winter > 0.99 }
	has_global_flag = zin_cold_winter_season
}

# The monthly anchor: Coldor, or the Cold Lands country with the most states; the month flag keeps a tie from running twice.
zin_cold_is_runner = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_cold_month_ran }
	OR = {
		original_tag = Y01
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = Y01 }
			zin_cold_is_cold = yes
			NOT = {
				any_other_country = {
					zin_cold_is_cold = yes
					check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
